sloka: सा हि जन्म च बाल्यं च यौवनं च महात्मनः।धर्मकार्यानुरूपं च रुदन्ती संस्मरिष्यति ।। ६.९३.५७ ।।
transliteration: sā hi janma ca bālyaṁ ca yauvanaṁ ca mahātmanaḥ।dharmakāryānurūpaṁ ca rudantī saṁsmariṣyati ।। 6.93.57 ।।

translations.english: 'Kausalya will think her only son has been killed in the battle. I think her heart would break'.
